7985721278640.title: Femme Fatale
7985721278640.description:
Femme Fatal begins with an exhilarating rush of pepper, crisp apple, juicy pineapple, and green galbanum, creating a bright, modern spark that commands attention. The heart melts into a cool, aromatic blend of mint, sage, and lavandin, capturing a confident femininity with effortless charm. In the drydown, creamy sandalwood, warm tonka bean, earthy moss, and sensual amberwood leave behind a silky, irresistible trail.

A fragrance crafted for the woman who is soft in her steps, sharp in her presence, and unforgettable in every moment she passes.

Composition:
notes: Amber, Musky, Sweet, Woody, Floral, Fruity, Powdery, Animatic, Soft Spicy

Type: Woody

Size: 100 ml

8041533866160.title: Oud Mystique
8041533866160.description:
Oud Mystique is a fragrance that captures the essence of dark elegance and quiet power. It opens with the luminous warmth of saffron—spicy, golden, and instantly captivating—setting the tone for a scent that feels both rich and intriguing.

At its heart, Turkish rose unfolds in full bloom, adding a velvety softness that balances the intensity with a refined floral depth. As it evolves, the composition deepens into the smoky richness of oud, creating a bold, woody character that lingers with undeniable presence.

Anchored by the sensual warmth of ambergris, Oud Mystique leaves behind a smooth, long-lasting trail—mysterious, sophisticated, and unforgettable. Designed for those who move with confidence and embrace the allure of the unknown, this fragrance is a statement of timeless luxury.

Composition:
Notes: Saffron, Oud, Turkish Rose, Ambergris

Type: Woody

Size: 100 ml

Note: Fragrances are not shipped internationally due to shipping policies.

7839318900912.title: Oud nocturne
7839318900912.description:
Lulusar brings you Oud Nocturne—a deep, sensual blend that unfolds like dusk turning into night. It opens with the soft elegance of rose touched by saffron’s quiet spice. At its heart, oud and akigalawood layer over warm praline and amber, creating a rich, textured warmth. A base of vanilla and musk lingers long after, soft and magnetic. Bold yet refined, Oud Nocturne is made for moments that leave an impression.

Composition:
Top notes: Rose, Saffron
Heart Notes: Praline, Agarwood (Oud), Akigalawood, White Amber
Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk

Type: Musky

Size: 100 ml

Note: Fragrances are not shipped internationally due to shipping policies.

8041533833392.title: Seraphina
8041533833392.description:
Seraphina is a fragrance that unfolds like a quiet luxury—rich, radiant, and deeply captivating. It opens with the golden glow of saffron, adding a subtle spice that feels both modern and timeless. At its heart, the opulence of Turkish rose blooms, soft yet intense, weaving a floral elegance that lingers gracefully on the skin.

As the scent settles, the depth of oud emerges—smoky, woody, and irresistibly sensual—balanced beautifully by the smooth, oceanic warmth of ambergris. Together, they create a long-lasting trail that feels refined, mysterious, and effortlessly sophisticated.

Seraphina is not just a fragrance—it’s an aura of confidence, designed for those who appreciate depth, elegance, and a touch of intrigue.

Composition:
Notes: Black Currant, Mild Saffron, Patchouli

Type: Fresh

Size: 100 ml

Note: Fragrances are not shipped internationally due to shipping policies.
